title: GEMglAlphaFunc

messages.description: reference value that incoming alpha values are compared to

arguments.description: reference value that incoming alpha values are compared to

body: [GEMglAlphaFunc] calls glAlphaFunc() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glAlphaFunc in the OpenGL reference.
